Affidavit of proprietorship in origi nal duly notarized (Latest). 2. The Average Annual financial turnover during the last 3 years financial year should b e at least ₹1 Lakh. TECHNICAL PRE-QUALIFICATION CRITERIA: Condition 1: Bidder must have satisfactorily executed similar nature of work during last seven (07) years endi ng last day of the month previous to the one in which NIT is published and shall meet either of th e following work order criteria mentioned below: One similar nature executed value not less than the amount equal to ₹1,56,940.00 ‘OR’ Two similar natures executed value each not less than the amount equal to ₹98,088.00 OR’ Three similar natures executed value each not less than the amount equal to ₹78,470.00 Note: Amount mentioned is exclusive of GST. 1. The Word “Similar Nature of Work” Bidder must have experience in Execution of Epox y Painting, Protective Coating, Industrial Painting, Equipment Preservation or similar main tenance works involving electrical motors, electrical equipment, structures, piping, tanks or process equipment in industrial plants. Documents required (To be Submitted along with technical bid): 1. Copy of Work Order (WO)/PO/rate contract/ agreement with following details: a.
